name: Mediarium
description: One self-hosted app that finds, downloads and organises movies, TV, music, ebooks and audiobooks: the jobs of Radarr, Sonarr, Prowlarr and SABnzbd in one program, with a built-in Usenet downloader, torrent client, subtitles, request portal and family accounts.

notes.text: The first visit to the web page creates the administrator account and walks through setup.

Media folders are /mnt/media/downloads, /mnt/media/movies, /mnt/media/tv and /mnt/media/music. Bind-mount your storage at /mnt/media (keep downloads and libraries on the same storage so imports are instant hardlinks), or change the paths in /opt/mediarium/.env and restart the service.
Settings, the database and its encryption key live in /opt/mediarium/config. Back that folder up.
